label: Modified command theory over a nature-fixed profile family
term: modified command theory over a profile family
definition: A CommandLayer over a profile family supplies acts, profile-relative act goodness, commands and obligations. ModifiedCommandTheory says that in every profile an act is obligatory exactly when commanded, and every commanded act is good. Command variation: some profile with the base natures has different commands. Obligation invariance: every profile with the base natures has the base obligations.
note: Analyst formulation of the split view associated with modified divine command theory (goodness fixed by the divine nature, obligation by command); attribution deferred, Adams is an unread lead. No link from act goodness to aspect goodness is assumed.
